utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going, Ira?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s going well so far — folks are dropping off tools and parts, and I’ve been running around collecting the last few bits.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good to hear. Do you still need anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can lend a hand with the repair drive. What tools or supplies do you need?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I’m still figuring that out, honestly. If you’ve got a wrench and some spare screws, that’d be a great start.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet — I’ve got a wrench and some spare screws I can bring over. Just let me know where to meet you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good bit of support already—folks are really pitching in. If you want, I can keep you posted on what else I hear.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be helpful, thanks. I’m just trying to figure out the timing and what still needs to be brought in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear the timing and any missing items. Hopefully we get a clear list soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you pick up the donated tools from the community center and bring them to my porch on Maple Street?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll pick up the donated tools from the community center and bring them to your porch on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’ve already started letting folks know — I can spread the word to a few more neighbors if you want.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’d appreciate that — just keep it simple and quiet for now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep it simple and quiet, and just tell a few people nearby.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, I’m glad you’re here — I’m getting the repair drive organized and would love your help. Have you seen any homes on the block that need attention?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve noticed a few loose fence boards by the corner house and one porch light out near Maple. I can point them out if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be great, Leo — thank you. Let’s check those spots together and I’ll add them to the list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to confirm the details first—what time is the repair drive, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late to the details, but I can check and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — that works. Please let me know once you’ve checked the time and what I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive—what time window are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a huge help, thank you. I’m thinking late Saturday morning, maybe 10 to 12, so folks can drop by after errands.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Late Saturday morning works for me — I can help keep it clear around the school schedule. Want me to see if we can get a few volunteers lined up for 10 to 12?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m a bit behind on the repair drive—what’s the latest? I’ve been hearing bits and pieces, but nothing solid.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely — we’ve got a good mix of folks signed up, and we’re mostly sorting out who’s handling supplies and pickup times. If you want, I can fill you in on what still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great — I’m still catching up, so just point me to whatever needs help most.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just bring the drill and a couple of screws—can you confirm you still have them?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I still have the drill and a couple screws. I’ll bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad the repair drive is happening. If you need a hand with anything, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rey — I might take you up on that. I’m a bit scatterbrained, so having an extra hand would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — just tell me where you want me to start, and I’ll help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plans so everyone stays in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on the supply list and let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep sharing the repair drive updates with folks as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s going steady so far — a few folks have already pitched in, and we’re still sorting out what’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s good to hear — I’ll keep an ear out for what’s still needed when I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered, but I can help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I’ll keep it simple and repeat the plan if you need. We can figure out what to bring for the repair drive together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik. If you tell me what’s needed, I’ll do my best to bring something useful.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. Did something change with it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not yet—still on for Saturday. I’ll send the details once I have them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — Saturday works for me. Thanks, Leo.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if you need tools for the repair drive, I’ve got a few you can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll make a clear list and stop by for whatever I need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — bring the list by anytime and I’ll set aside whatever I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn — I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive. What do you need me to help with first?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great to hear, Mara — could you start by helping me spread the word to a few neighbors? I’ll handle the sign-up sheet and tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll start reaching out to a few neighbors right away. If you want, I can also mention the sign-up sheet so people know how to get involved.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help bring folks together for the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you help me confirm which homes are on the repair list and which ones need pickup or drop-off? That’d let me keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I can help with that. Send me the repair list, and I’ll sort out which homes need pickup or drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted on the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye on our supplies and make sure we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Cleo — I’ll send out the sign-up details and a quick checklist so we stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive was coming up, but I’m still getting the details second-hand. What did you hear about it, Mina?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I only heard it’s this Saturday and they’re taking small home repairs. Do you want me to check the flyer and tell you the exact time?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—that would help a lot. I’m still piecing it together from word of mouth.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you bring the drill and a couple of screwdrivers? If you can, come by after school pickup and we’ll sort the rest out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can do that. I’ll swing by after school pickup with the drill and a couple screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still in for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m still in for the repair drive.
